_about: Tour suggestions – every number the method uses, read again on each request. Nothing here is per region: what is good is measured against the place itself (place.py). docs/design/tour-suggestions.md explains the method.

activities._about: wild = where the activity (and for hikes the T level) sits on the character scale 0 gemütlich … 1 wild. profile = the app's BRouter profile. pace = km/h on the flat.

family._about: What differs between going on foot and on wheels. ground = how welcome [paved, firm, natural, rough] ground is at the gemütlich and the wild end. up_m_per_h = usual metres of ascent per hour at the gemütlich and the wild end (with the effort it gives the ascent range). ascent_m_per_h = time model: hours = km / pace + ascent / this. band_km = a single wished time is widened by this many kilometres either way to a range. free_stem_m = a way out and back this long costs nothing. road_walk_max_m = longest stretch along a road with cars outside a town (0 = no limit). reach_max_m / coarse = how much way network is loaded (wheels: minor ways left out unless a signed route runs on them). sectors / pairs / chains / lines = how many loops each generator tries.

character._about: Level 3 – what this person wants, from gemütlich to wild (linear in between). axes = weight of the five axes. depth = how much of Natur is being deep inside nature rather than green beside the way. signed = how much a signed route counts as something special.

controls._about: The page's few controls only nudge the character. level = factor on an axis weight (Natur, Ruhe) or on signed routes (Bekannte Wege). surface = step on the character scale for the ground only. effort = the ascent range when none is given: [from, to] x the usual metres up per hour of this character x the hours wished. water = with 'am Wasser entlang' water is what counts as special, and Besonderes weighs this much more.

facts._about: Level 1 – thresholds that turn tags and map into facts, the same everywhere. road = how much a road class counts as 'with cars'; calm = factor at 30 km/h; beside = a separate way right beside a road counts this share of it; beside_from = roads from this weight on count for 'beside'; big_water = share of open water within 300 m from which a bank is big water; rank = signed route networks.

place._about: Level 2 – the place as the yardstick. A value is poor at the `low` quantile of the ways in reach and full at the `high` one (at least min_span apart). standout = the best share of the ground here: connected it forms the areas and lines the loops aim at; an area counts from min_area x the wished length. access_built = the way out ends where less than this share of the ways runs through houses; access_max = at most this share of the wished length counts as the unavoidable way out.

search._about: How the cheapest way is found: metres x (1 + taste x (1 - how good the way is here)) x (1 + road x traffic). used = factor on a way already in the loop, beside_used = on ways touching it (keeps the way home apart, so nothing is doubled or crossed), line = factor on the ways of a line that is being followed. radius = network loaded around the start, as a share of the wished length.

form._about: The Form axis and the few hard rules. Inside the wished ranges of time and ascent every loop is equally fine. short_zero = share below the shortest wished time at which the time part is 0; long_zero = share above the longest from which a loop is no longer offered; under the wished ascent the part falls gently, above it the loop is not offered. doubled_zero = share walked twice (beyond the free stem) at which that part is 0. cross = factor for one meeting with the own way; max_cross = more meetings than this are never offered. view = bonus per viewpoint passed.

select._about: max suggestions; a further one may share at most `overlap` of its way (beyond the common way out) with one already shown and must not be more than `behind` points below the first; what stands out in reach (a top line such as the river with 'am Wasser entlang', an area) gets one suggestion if its best loop is within cover_behind points.
